notes: kotaemon is a library (libs/kotaemon) + Gradio app (libs/ktem); both are shipped, so both are prod. All model/client config flows through spec dicts (flowsettings.KH_LLMS/KH_EMBEDDINGS, ktem setup page, Resources UI) deserialized from the ktem DB; the API key is the operator's (global model pool, no per-user keys). Sites are the SDK calls inside the wrapper classes, not the spec dicts. Not counted (not LLM generation/embedding API sites): Cohere/Voyage/TEI rerankers, VoyageAI embeddings SDK (embeddings, would be kept), TEI embeddings HTTP, FastEmbed/HF/LlamaCpp local models, Ollama /api/pull in ktem/pages/setup.py, Tavily/Jina web search, tiktoken uses of 'gpt-3.5-turbo'. Tests (libs/kotaemon/tests, libs/ktem/ktem_tests), docs and the cookiecutter template only construct kotaemon wrapper classes (AzureChatOpenAI, OpenAIEmbeddings, LCAzureChatOpenAI...) with openai SDK calls patched; they contain no direct SDK call sites, so no nonprod sites are listed.
